title: NS-Forest Version 2 Analysis Protocol
author: Brian Aevermann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.un7evhn
materials: Required libraries: Numpy, Pandas, Sklearn, graphviz, numexpr
Generates a matrix of cluster median expression values

steps.title: Prepare Environment and Data Matrix
steps.instruction: Set up the analysis environment and format the input gene expression matrix.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the environment uses Python 2.7 with Numpy, Pandas, Sklearn, graphviz, and numexpr libraries.
Build a Cell by Gene matrix (tsv or csv) using normalized or raw count expression values.
Ensure the first column contains gene IDs and the first row contains user-defined cell IDs.
Strip gene IDs/symbols of characters such as '.', '-', and '@', replacing them with '_' or 'at'.
Add a column named ' Clusters ' where each cell is uniquely assigned a string cluster label.

steps.title: Initialize Data and Parameters
steps.instruction: Load the data into the Jupyter notebook and configure the Random Forest parameters.

substeps.instruction: Modify the first line of code to include the file path: dataFull = pd.read_table("Your/Path/Here", index_col = 0).
Allow the script to create and add dummy binary columns to the matrix for one vs all Random Forest modeling.
Generate a matrix of cluster median expression values.
Verify the number of dummy columns (clusters) printed to the screen.
Adjust tunable parameters as needed: rfTrees=10000, threads=1 (or -1 for all CPUs/RAM), InformativeGenes=15, Genes_to_testing=6, and setBeta=0.5.

steps.title: Execute Core Algorithm
steps.instruction: Run the NS-Forest core algorithm to identify marker genes.

substeps.instruction: Iterate through dummy columns one at a time in the main loop.
Generate a Random Forest model for each column.
Extract and sort feature variables by importance to create the first ranked gene list.
Compute the Binary score for the top 15 genes.
Re-sort genes based on Binary score, then importance, to create the second ranked gene list.
Use the top 6 genes to produce individual decision trees to determine optimal expression threshold cutoffs.
Permute the top 6 genes using AND logic and the determined threshold cutoffs, computing and storing the fbeta-score for each combination.

steps.title: Generate Analysis Reports
steps.instruction: Review the four reports generated by the NS-Forest tool.

substeps.instruction: Binary ranking table: Review binary scores and Gini information for genes used in combinations.
Complete results: Review genes, number of markers, and fbeta-scores for all tested combinations.
Top f-beta results (no genes): Review cluster names and their maximum fbeta-scores.
Top markers results for each cluster: Review the subset of complete results using a rank that accounts for ties.
